title: India news: Delhi air quality level 'severe' after Diwali
summary: Illegal fireworks during Diwali celebrations have impacted New Delhi's air quality level. DW has the latest.

image.caption: New Delhi is one of the world's most polluted capitalsImage: Anushree Fadnavis/REUTERS

blocks.text: Illegal fireworks during Diwali celebrations have impacted New Delhi's air quality level. DW has the latest.

blocks.caption: New Delhi is one of the world's most polluted capitalsImage: Anushree Fadnavis/REUTERS

blocks.text: Here is our rolling coverage from India on Monday, November 9:

items: Delhi's air quality has significantly worsened as Diwali celebrations saw people violating a ban on conventional firecrackers
Smog has engulfed the Indian capital's roads and high-rises, reducing visibility
One locality reportedly witnessed PM 2.5 levels rising to over 58 times the WHO recommended daily limit

blocks.text: Nineteen Indian seafarers who had been stranded in Yemen's Hodeidah and Sanaa for nearly two weeks have been evacuated, the Indian Embassy in Yemen said in a post on X late Sunday.
The embassy added that the sailors were in good health and on their way back to India.
A 2022 truce that had paused fighting in Yemen's longstanding conflict crumbled in July, restarting fighting between the Houthi rebels and the Middle Eastern country's Saudi Arabia-backed government.
According to India's foreign ministry, 23 Indian nationals have been killed since the Middle East war began in February, with seafarers accounting for 15 deaths.
